title: Why LLMs Struggle With Legacy Code
excerpt: Skewed training data, missing implicit context, undocumented business rules, invisible side effects, thin test coverage, and asymmetric risk. Plus a look at what purpose-built models, multi-agent pipelines, and dependency-aware retrieval are actually doing about it.

title: Machine Learning Refresher
excerpt: Going back to the fundamentals: supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning, and why it's worth revisiting the basics even when most of the day-to-day work is LLMs and agents.

title: 12 Must-Know GenAI Terms for Everyone in Tech
excerpt: A plain-language breakdown of the terms that come up constantly in generative AI right now: LLMs, transformers, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, temperature, hallucination, and more.
